chunks.l2:
[vbt-p01-v10] For meditation's sake — for confused minds, for dwellers in pompous rite — it is described merely, for men whose selves are struck by fancy.

[vbt-p01-v02] Even now the doubt is not dispelled in me, O highest Lord: what form is it in truth, O god — made of the heap of words and digits?

[vbt-p01-v03] Is it the ninefold self, divided — Bhairava, Bhairava's form; split by the three-headed division, or, what, the nature of the three powers?

[vbt-p01-v04] Or made of nāda's drop? Or the checkers of the moon's half? Mounted on the wheel, unsmeared? Or what, the power-formed?

[vbt-p01-v05] Of higher and lower, the whole — and of the lower, or again: but if the higher be that way, its higher-ness is contradicted.

[vbt-p01-v06] For it cannot come about by letter-division, or by dividing bodies: higher-ness is partlessness — not that, in wholeness.

[vbt-p01-v08] Most worthy of hiding, O fortunate one — yet I will tell you whatever whole form of Bhairava is proclaimed.

[vbt-p01-v09] That must be known by its unsubstantialness, O Goddess — like Indra's net; like a māyā-dream, and indeed, the error of Gandharva cities.
chunks.sanskrit: adyāpi na nivṛtto me saṃśayaḥ parameśvara | kiṃ rūpaṃ tattvato deva śabdarāśikalāmayam kiṃ vā navātmabhedena bhairave bhairavākṛtau | triśirobhedabhinnaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktitrayātmakam nādabindumayaṃ vāpi kiṃ candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | cakrārūḍham anackaṃ vā kiṃ vā śaktisvarūpakam parāparāyāḥ sakalam aparāyāś ca vā punaḥ | parāyā yadi tadvat syāt paratvaṃ tad virudhyate na hi varṇavibhedena dehabhedena vā bhavet | paratvaṃ niṣkalatvena sakalatve na tad bhavet prasādaṃ kuru me nātha niḥśeṣaṃ chinddhi saṃśayam | bhairava uvāca | sādhu sādhu tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ tantrasāram idam priye gūhanīyatamam bhadre tathāpi kathayāmi te | yatkiṃcit sakalaṃ rūpaṃ bhairavasya prakīrtitam tad asāratayā devi vijñeyaṃ śakrajālavat | māyāsvapnopamaṃ caiva gandharvanagarabhramam dhyānārtham bhrāntabuddhīnāṃ kriyāḍambaravartinām | kevalaṃ varṇitam puṃsāṃ vikalpanihatātmanām tattvato na navātmāsau śabdarāśir na bhairavaḥ | na cāsau triśirā devo na ca śaktitrayātmakaḥ

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p02-v12] Not made of nāda's drop, either; not the checkers of the moon; not joined to the wheel's course, not the power-formed.

[vbt-p02-v13] These terrors of unawakened minds are strong indeed; like a mother's sweet, all of it is declared for the sake of going on.

[vbt-p02-v14] Free of direction, time and counting — with no particular place or point: it cannot be pointed out; untellable in the end.

[vbt-p02-v15] Joy of inner self-taste, unhoused in fancy's range — that full-formed state, Bhairavī, of Bhairava's own self.

[vbt-p02-v16] That body must be known in truth: stainless, filling the world — in such a supreme reality, who is worshipped, and which one is pleased?

[vbt-p02-v17] Whatever state of Bhairava's is sung like this: she is the supreme one — proclaimed the supreme goddess as the supreme form.

[vbt-p02-v18] As the non-difference of power and the powerful stands always — hence, from that property-owning, the supreme power of the supreme self.

[vbt-p02-v19] No power separate from fire's burning is conceived; only in knowing-being, in entering, does this beginning arise.

[vbt-p02-v20] Of one entered into the power-state, contemplation without division — then he becomes Śiva-formed: that mouth is called Śaivī.
chunks.sanskrit: nādabindumayo vāpi na candrārdhanirodhikāḥ | na cakrakramasambhinno na ca śaktisvarūpakaḥ aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam dikkālakalanonmuktā deśoddeśāviśeṣinī | vyapadeṣṭum aśakyāsāv akathyā paramārthataḥ antaḥsvānubhavānandā vikalponmuktagocarā | yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavī bhairavātmanaḥ tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati evaṃvidhā bhairavasya yāvasthā parigīyate | sā parā pararūpeṇa parā devī prakīrtitā śaktiśaktimator yadvad abhedaḥ sarvadā sthitaḥ | atas taddharmadharmitvāt parā śaktiḥ parātmanaḥ na vahner dāhikā śaktir vyatiriktā vibhāvyate | kevalaṃ jñānasattāyām prārambho 'yam praveśane śaktyavasthāpraviṣṭasya nirvibhāgena bhāvanā | tadāsau śivarūpī syāt śaivī mukham ihocyate yathālokena dīpasya kiraṇair bhāskarasya ca | jñāyate digvibhāgādi tadvac chaktyā śivaḥ priye

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p03-v22] God of gods, marked with the trident, adorned with the skull: void of direction, place and time — and free of designation.

[vbt-p03-v23] What is that full-formed state of Bhairava, and by what means does its door open, O supreme Goddess? Tell me as you rightly know it, Bhairava.

[vbt-p03-v24] Breath above, life below, and the emission-natured one should utter forth: at the two arising places, filled from filling, standing.

[vbt-p03-v25] Of wind within or without, or even from the sky-pair not turning; by Bhairavī — of Bhairava thus, O Bhairavī, the manifested form.

[vbt-p03-v26] Neither should it go nor enter, the wind-formed power when it blossoms; by thoughtlessness in the middle — by her, Bhairava-formness.

[vbt-p03-v27] Whether kumbhaka-held, or exhaled, or inhaled — when it may be so: at its end this is called calm; by power, calm shines forth.

[vbt-p03-v28] From the root, ray-shining; from the subtle, the subtler-natured — contemplate her at the twelve's end, calming down: Bhairava's rise.

[vbt-p03-v29] Rising up, lightning-formed, wheel by wheel, step by step; upward to three fists — until, then at the end, the great rise.

[vbt-p03-v30] Twelvefold course rightly, divided by twelve letters; through gross, subtle, supreme standing — freed, freed at last: Śiva.
chunks.sanskrit: śrī devy uvāca | devadeva triśūlāṅka kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇa | digdeśakālaśūnyā ca vyapadeśavivarjitā yāvasthā bharitākārā bhairavasyopalabhyate | kair upāyair mukhaṃ tasya parā devi katham bhavet | yathā samyag ahaṃ vedmi tathā me brūhi bhairava bhairava uvāca | ūrdhve prāṇo hy adho jīvo visargātmā paroccaret | utpattidvitayasthāne bharaṇād bharitā sthitiḥ maruto 'ntar bahir vāpi viyadyugmānivartanāt | bhairavyā bhairavasyettham bhairavi vyajyate vapuḥ na vrajen na viśec chaktir marudrūpā vikāsite | nirvikalpatayā madhye tayā bhairavarūpatā kumbhitā recitā vāpi pūritā vā yadā bhavet | tadante śāntanāmāsau śaktyā śāntaḥ prakāśate āmūlāt kiraṇābhāsāṃ sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarātmikam | cintayet tāṃ dviṣaṭkānte śyāmyantīm bhairavodayaḥ udgacchantīṃ taḍitrūpām praticakraṃ kramāt kramam | ūrdhvaṃ muṣṭitrayaṃ yāvat tāvad ante mahodayaḥ kramadvādaśakaṃ samyag dvādaśākṣarabheditam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā muktvā muktvāntataḥ śivaḥ tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā | nirvikalpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā sarvordhve sarvagodgamaḥ

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p04-v32] With peacock feathers, with varied forms, with circles, in the five-void: of the meditating one, in the unsurpassed void, entry in the heart may be.

[vbt-p04-v33] By just such course — wherever thought: in void, on the wall, on the supreme, on the vessel, self dissolved — the boon-giving.

[vbt-p04-v34] Inside the skull, mind placed; standing with eyes half closed: in order, from the mind's firmness, mark the to-be-marked — the highest.

[vbt-p04-v35] Middle channel, standing in the middle, like a lotus-fiber; by the meditated inner sky, O Goddess — by that, god shines forth.

[vbt-p04-v36] By the hand-blocked gaze-weapon, from the brow's splitting, from the door's blocking; when seen in the drop, in order, when dissolved — in that middle, the supreme standing.

[vbt-p04-v37] The mark of subtle fire born of dwelling-inner-churn — the drop at the crest's end, in the heart, at dissolution's end: for the meditating one, dissolving.

[vbt-p04-v38] In the unstruck, in the vessel-ear, in the broken sound, in the river's rushing; bathed in word-brahman, the supreme brahman is attained.

[vbt-p04-v39] From the prolonged utterance of oṃ and the rest, at the prolonged end, from contemplating void: by void, by supreme power — to voidness she goes, O Bhairavī.

[vbt-p04-v40] Of any letter whatsoever, the beginning and end should be contemplated: by void, become void, that man becomes void-formed.
chunks.sanskrit: śikhipakṣaiś citrarūpair ma.ṅdalaiḥ śūnyapañcakam | dhyāyato 'nuttare śūnye praveśo hṛdaye bhavet īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā | śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā kapālāntar mano nyasya tiṣṭhan mīlitalocanaḥ | krameṇa manaso dārḍhyāt lakṣayet laṣyam uttamam madhyanāḍī madhyasaṃsthā bisasūtrābharūpayā | dhyātāntarvyomayā devyā tayā devaḥ prakāśate kararuddhadṛgastreṇa bhrūbhedād dvārarodhanāt | dṛṣṭe bindau kramāl līne tanmadhye paramā sthitiḥ dhāmāntaḥkṣobhasambhūtasūkṣmāgnitilakākṛtim | binduṃ śikhānte hṛdaye layānte dhyāyato layaḥ anāhate pātrakarṇe 'bhagnaśabde sariddrute | śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahmādhigacchati praṇavādisamuccārāt plutānte śūnyabhāvānāt | śūnyayā parayā śaktyā śūnyatām eti bhairavi yasya kasyāpi varṇasya pūrvāntāv anubhāvayet | śūnyayā śūnyabhūto 'sau śūnyākāraḥ pumān bhavet tantryādivādyaśabdeṣu dīrgheṣu kramasaṃsthiteḥ | ananyacetāḥ pratyante paravyomavapur bhavet

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p05-v42] Of the body-mantra of all, by the gross-letter course — ending in moon-drop-sound: from void uttering, one may become Śiva.

[vbt-p05-v43] In one's own body, all directions at once should be contemplated as sky; with undirected mind — of him, sky proceeds everywhere.

[vbt-p05-v44] The back-void and the root-void at once should be contemplated, and whoever: by the body-disregarding power, void-minded he may be.

[vbt-p05-v45] Back-void, root-void, heart-void should be contemplated steady: at once, from thoughtlessness — thoughtless-rising follows.

[vbt-p05-v46] In a place of the body, voidness indeed — for a mere moment should be envisioned: thoughtless, thoughtless, sharing thoughtless nature.

[vbt-p05-v47] All gone in the body-stuff, pervaded by sky, O deer-eyed one: should be envisioned then — of him, the contemplation may grow steady.

[vbt-p05-v48] Inside the body, the skin-division should be thought through as a wall: nothing inside it — for the meditating one, the one beyond the meditated's share may be.

[vbt-p05-v49] In the heart-sky, eyes hidden, gone to the middle of the lotus-casket: with undivided mind, O fortunate one — supreme fortune may be won.

[vbt-p05-v50] From all around one's own body, at the twelve's end, from mind-dissolving: of firm-minded made firm, the reality-mark proceeds.
chunks.sanskrit: pi.ṅdamantrasya sarvasya sthūlavarṇakrameṇa tu | ardhendubindunādāntaḥ śūnyoccārād bhavec chivaḥ nijadehe sarvadikkaṃ yugapad bhāvayed viyat | nirvikalpamanās tasya viyat sarvam pravartate pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ yugapad bhāvayec ca yaḥ | śarīranirapekṣiṇyā śaktyā śūnyamanā bhavet pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ hṛcchūnyam bhāvayet sthiram | yugapan nirvikalpatvān nirvikalpodayas tataḥ tanūdeśe śūnyataiva kṣaṇamātraṃ vibhāvayet | nirvikalpaṃ nirvikalpo nirvikalpasvarūpabhāk sarvaṃ dehagataṃ dravyaṃ viyadvyāptaṃ mṛgekṣaṇe | vibhāvayet tatas tasya bhāvanā sā sthirā bhavet dehāntare tvagvibhāgam bhittibhūtaṃ vicintayet | na kiṃcid antare tasya dhyāyann adhyeyabhāg bhavet hṛdyākāśe nilīnākṣaḥ padmasampuṭamadhyagaḥ | ananyacetāḥ subhage paraṃ saubhāgyam āpnuyāt sarvataḥ svaśarīrasya dvādaśānte manolayāt | dṛḍhabuddher dṛḍhībhūtaṃ tattvalakṣyam pravartate yathā tathā yatra tatra dvādaśānte manaḥ kṣipet || pratikṣaṇaṃ kṣīṇavṛtter vailakṣaṇyaṃ dinair bhavet

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p06-v52] By the time-fire, arisen from the time-place — one's own city should be thought burnt; at the end, calm-shining, then it may be.

[vbt-p06-v53] Thus, indeed, the whole world burnt — having meditated, away from fancy: in the non-other mind of the man, manliness supreme may be.

[vbt-p06-v54] In one's own body, the world's or even the minute-minuter things and realities — their abiding contemplated at the end, the supreme is manifested.

[vbt-p06-v55] The thin and weak power, meditated at the twelve's range: having entered, meditating in the heart — freed, freedom may be won.

[vbt-p06-v56] The world-course and the rest formed, in order, all: through gross, subtle, supreme standing — as long as, at the end, mind-dissolves.

[vbt-p06-v57] Of this, of all, of the world — at the ends everywhere; by path-procedure, Śiva-reality meditated: the great rise.

[vbt-p06-v58] The universe, this, O great Goddess, void-become should be thought; right there and mind merged — then, of that, the vessel of merging.

[vbt-p06-v59] In a pot and such a vessel, the gaze — the wall left, cast well: at that dissolving, in that moment gone — made of that he may be.

[vbt-p06-v60] In a treeless mountain, a wall, such a place — the gaze should be cast well: when dissolved in mind, in that state, the wasting of turning is born.
chunks.sanskrit: kālāgninā kālapadād utthitena svakam puram | pluṣṭam vicintayed ante śāntābhāsas tadā bhavet evam eva jagat sarvaṃ dagdhaṃ dhyātvā vikalpataḥ | ananyacetasaḥ puṃsaḥ pumbhāvaḥ paramo bhavet svadehe jagato vāpi sūkṣmasūkṣmatarāṇi ca | tattvāni yāni nilayaṃ dhyātvānte vyajyate parā pināṃ ca durbalāṃ śaktiṃ dhyātvā dvādaśagocare | praviśya hṛdaye dhyāyan muktaḥ svātantryam āpnuyāt bhuvanādhvādirūpeṇa cintayet kramaśo 'khilam | sthūlasūkṣmaparasthityā yāvad ante manolayaḥ asya sarvasya viśvasya paryanteṣu samantataḥ | adhvaprakriyayā tattvaṃ śaivaṃ dhyatvā mahodayaḥ viśvam etan mahādevi śūnyabhūtaṃ vicintayet | tatraiva ca mano līnaṃ tatas tallayabhājanam ghatādibhājane dṛṣṭim bhittis tyaktvā vinikṣipet | tallayaṃ tatkṣaṇād gatvā tallayāt tanmayo bhavet nirvṛkṣagiribhittyādideśe dṛṣṭiṃ vinikṣipet | vilīne mānase bhāve vṛttikṣiṇaḥ prajāyate ubhayor bhāvayor jñāne dhyātvā madhyaṃ samāśrayet | yugapac ca dvayaṃ tyaktvā madhye tattvam prakāśate

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p07-v62] When the state is abandoned, the restrained consciousness does not go to any other state: then, in that middle-being, contemplation expands exceedingly.

[vbt-p07-v63] All body consciousness-made — or the world indeed, fancy fully: at once, by undivided mind, the supreme rise.

[vbt-p07-v64] Of the two winds, from their clashing — inside or outside, at the limit: the yogin, of the rising of evenness-knowing, becomes the vessel of offering.

[vbt-p07-v65] All world, or one's own body, filled with one's own bliss should be remembered: at once with one's own nectar indeed — full of supreme bliss he may be.

[vbt-p07-v66] By trick, by application — at once indeed, O deer-eyed one: great bliss manifests, by which reality shines forth.

[vbt-p07-v67] By binding all the channels, by the up-going breath-power, slowly: at the crawling-ant's moment, supreme happiness spreads forth.

[vbt-p07-v68] Between fire and poison, in the middle — the mind, happiness-made, should be cast: merely wind-filled, or yoked by remembrance-bliss.

[vbt-p07-v69] Agitated by union, shaking, at the end of power-penetration: whatever happiness of brahman-reality — that happiness, self-told, is told.

[vbt-p07-v70] By licking, churning, the pounding apexes — of woman-bliss from fullness, from memory: even in power's absence, O Goddess of gods, the bliss-flood may be.
chunks.sanskrit: bhāve tyakte niruddhā cin naiva bhāvāntaraṃ vrajet | tadā tanmadhyabhāvena vikasatyati bhāvanā sarvaṃ dehaṃ cinmayaṃ hi jagad vā paribhāvayet | yugapan nirvikalpena manasā paramodayaḥ vāyudvayasya saṃghaṭṭād antar vā bahir antataḥ | yogī samatvavijñānasamudgamanabhājanam sarvaṃ jagat svadehaṃ vā svānandabharitaṃ smaret | yugapat svāmṛtenaiva parānandamayo bhavet kuhanena prayogeṇa sadya eva mṛgekṣaṇe | samudeti mahānando yena tattvaṃ prakāśate sarvasrotonibandhena prāṇaśaktyordhvayā śanaiḥ | pipīlasparśavelāyām prathate paramaṃ sukham vahner viṣasya madhye tu cittaṃ sukhamayaṃ kṣipet | kevalaṃ vāyupūrṇaṃ vā smarānandena yujyate śaktisaṃgamasaṃkṣubdhaśaktyāveśāvasānikam | yat sukham brahmatattvasya tat sukhaṃ svākyam ucyate lehanāmanthanākoṭaiḥ strīsukhasya bharāt smṛteḥ | śaktyabhāve 'pi deveśi bhaved ānandasamplavaḥ ānande mahati prāpte dṛṣṭe vā bāndhave cirāt | ānandam udgataṃ dhyātvā tallayas tanmanā bhavet

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p08-v72] From eating and drinking, the swelling of joy, bliss-blooming: should be fancied the filled state — great bliss then may be.

[vbt-p08-v73] From tasting objects such as song — happiness not shared, one-selfness: of the yogin, by absorbedness, mounted in mind — in that selfness.

[vbt-p08-v74] Wherever the mind is content, right there the mind should be held: there, there — the own-form of supreme bliss proceeds forth.

[vbt-p08-v75] In the not-yet-come, in sleep, when the outer range has perished: that state, to be gone to by mind — the supreme Goddess shines forth.

[vbt-p08-v76] By the brilliance of sun, lamp and such, in the sky made dappled: gaze fixed right there — one's own self-form shines forth.

[vbt-p08-v77] By the skeleton, by the angry, by the licking Bhairavī, by the sky-going: at the gaze's time — the supreme attainment shines forth.

[vbt-p08-v78] On a soft seat, with one buttock, hands and feet unsupported placed: by that context — the supreme, full mind may be.

[vbt-p08-v79] Having sat on the seat rightly, arms, two, made half-bent: in the armpit-sky, mind making — calm comes by that dissolving.

[vbt-p08-v80] Of gross-formed state, fixed gaze cast down, and quickly: unsupported mind made — Śiva one may go to.
chunks.sanskrit: jagdhipānakṛtollāsarasānandavijṛmbhaṇāt | bhāvayed bharitāvasthāṃ mahānandas tato bhavet gitādiviṣayāsvādāsamasaukhyaikatātmanaḥ | yoginas tanmayatvena manorūḍhes tadātmatā yatra yatra manas tuṣṭir manas tatraiva dhārayet | tatra tatra parānandasvārūpaṃ sampravartate anāgatāyāṃ nidrāyām praṇaṣṭe bāhyagocare | sāvasthā manasā gamyā parā devī prakāśate tejasā sūryadīpāder ākāśe śabalīkṛte | dṛṣṭir niveśyā tatraiva svātmarūpam prakāśate karaṅkiṇyā krodhanayā bhairavyā lelihānayā | khecaryā dṛṣṭikāle ca parāvāptiḥ prakāśate mṛdvāsane sphijaikena hastapādau nirāśrayam | nidhāya tatprasaṅgena parā pūrṇā matir bhavet upaviśyāsane samyag bāhū kṛtvārdhakuñcitau | kakṣavyomni manaḥ kurvan śamam āyāti tallayāt sthūlarūpasya bhāvasya stabdhāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nipātya ca | acireṇa nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā śivaṃ vrajet madhyajihve sphāritāsye madhye nikṣipya cetanām | hoccāraṃ manasā kurvaṃs tataḥ śānte pralīyate

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p09-v82] On seat, on bed, having stood — unsupported, envisioning one's own body in mind: when mind wasted — in a moment, wasted-impurity may be.

[vbt-p09-v83] On a moving seat, standing now — slowly, or by the body's moving: in the calmed mind, in that state, O Goddess, the divine flood may be won.

[vbt-p09-v84] Sky, stainless, seeing — gaze made unbroken: stunned self at that moment, O Goddess, the Bhairava form may be won.

[vbt-p09-v85] Dissolved on the crown, sky all as Bhairava should be contemplated: that all — the Bhairava-form-blaze-reality may enter.

[vbt-p09-v86] Something known — duality-giving, outer light, darkness again: the universe-form of Bhairava — having known, endless-light-bearing.

[vbt-p09-v87] Thus indeed in bad night, on the dark fortnight's arrival, long: contemplating timira — Bhairava's form will come to.

[vbt-p09-v88] Thus indeed, having closed first the eyes, black lustre before: spread Bhairava's form, contemplating — made of that he may be.

[vbt-p09-v89] Of whichever organ even — from its striking and its blocking: of one entered in the nondual, in void — there itself the self shines forth.

[vbt-p09-v90] No drop, no emission, and the a-syllable of muttering great: rises, O Goddess, suddenly — knowledge-flood, the highest Lord.
chunks.sanskrit: āsane śayane sthitvā nirādhāraṃ vibhāvayan | svadehaṃ manasi kṣiṇe kṣaṇāt kṣīṇāśayo bhavet calāsane sthitasyātha śanair vā dehacālanāt | praśānte mānase bhāve devi divyaugham āpnuyāt ākāśaṃ vimalam paśyan kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ nirantarām | stabdhātmā tatkṣaṇād devi bhairavaṃ vapur āpnuyāt līnaṃ mūrdhni viyat sarvam bhairavatvena bhāvayet | tat sarvam bhairavākāratejastattvaṃ samāviśet kiñcij jñātaṃ dvaitadāyi bāhyālokas tamaḥ punaḥ | viśvādi bhairavaṃ rūpaṃ jñātvānantaprakāśabhṛt evam eva durniśāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāgame ciram | taimiram bhāvayan rūpam bhairavaṃ rūpam eṣyati evam eva nimīlyādau netre kṛṣṇābham agrataḥ | prasārya bhairavaṃ rūpam bhāvayaṃs tanmayo bhavet yasya kasyendriyasyāpi vyāghātāc ca nirodhataḥ | praviṣṭasyādvaye śūnye tatraivātmā prakāśate abindum avisargaṃ ca akāraṃ japato mahān | udeti devi sahasā jñānaughaḥ parameśvaraḥ varṇasya savisargasya visargāntaṃ citiṃ kuru | nirādhāreṇa cittena spṛśed brahma sanātanam

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p10-v100] Consciousness-natured in all bodies — distinction there is nowhere: hence, made of that, contemplating all — the world-conquering person.

[vbt-p10-v92] Sky-formed one's own self should be meditated, by directions uncovered: supportless awareness-power — own form will show it then.

[vbt-p10-v93] Something, a limb, pierced first — with sharp needle and such, then: right there, awareness yoked — in Bhairava, spotless going.

[vbt-p10-v94] Mind-and-the-rest, inner-making, is not inside me: think thus — by absence of fancies, fancies abandoned may be.

[vbt-p10-v95] Māyā, the deluding one, named: the counting of the parts stands; counting the such-and-such natures of realities — not separately may be.

[vbt-p10-v96] Sudden desire arisen — having seen it, to calm should lead it: where it indeed arose, there right there it dissolves.

[vbt-p10-v97] When my desire is unarisen — knowing, or what — then I am indeed: truly He-I, thus become, in that dissolved, that-minded may be.

[vbt-p10-v98] In desire or in knowing, when arisen — mind should be set: self-mind, undivided-minded — then the seeing of reality's meaning.

[vbt-p10-v99] Causeless may be the knowing, supportless, error-natured: truly not anyone's — thus becoming Śiva, O dear.
chunks.sanskrit: vyomākāraṃ svam ātmānaṃ dhyāyed digbhir anāvṛtam | nirāśrayā citiḥ śaktiḥ svarūpaṃ darśayet tadā kiṃcid aṅgaṃ vibhidyādau tīkṣṇasūcyādinā tataḥ | tatraiva cetanāṃ yuktvā bhairave nirmalā gatiḥ cittādyantaḥkṛtir nāsti mamāntar bhāvayed iti | vikalpānām abhāvena vikalpair ujjhito bhavet māyā vimohinī nāma kalāyāḥ kalanaṃ sthitam | ityādidharmaṃ tattvānāṃ kalayan na pṛthag bhavet jhagitīcchāṃ samutpannām avalokya śamaṃ nayet | yata eva samudbhūtā tatas tatraiva līyate yadā mamecchā notpannā jñānaṃ vā kas tadāsmi vai | tattvato =B9haṃ tathābhūtas tallīnas tanmanā bhavet icchāyām athavā jñāne jāte cittaṃ niveśayet | ātmabuddhyānanyacetās tatas tattvārthadarśanam nirnimittam bhavej jñānaṃ nirādhāram bhramātmakam | tattvataḥ kasyacin naitad evambhāvī śivaḥ priye ciddharmā sarvadeheṣu viśeṣo nāsti kutracit | ataś ca tanmayaṃ sarvam bhāvayan bhavajij janaḥ kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryagocare | buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p11-v102] The world, Indra-net-made, cast — or picture-work-like; whirling, or the meditating one's all: and seeing — joy upsurges.

[vbt-p11-v103] Not into pain should the mind be cast, not into joy, nor scattered about: O Bhairavī — in the middle, what reality remains may be known.

[vbt-p11-v104] Having left the own-body-standing, contemplating everywhere-I-am-thus: with firm mind, by a gaze not seeing elsewhere — happy may he be.

[vbt-p11-v105] In a pot and such — whatever knowing; desire and such, or inside me: never all-pervading born — contemplating thus, all-going.

[vbt-p11-v106] Grasper-grasped awareness: common to all embodied; of yogins the distinction but — He is, in relation, carefulness.

[vbt-p11-v107] Like self in another body — He even should perceive awareness: regard of one's own body having left, pervasive in days may he be.

[vbt-p11-v108] Supportless mind having been made — thoughts should not be thought: then, in self-supreme-self — Bhairava, O deer-eyed one.

[vbt-p11-v109] All-knowing, all-doing, and pervasive, the highest Lord: he indeed I — Śiva-natured; hence from firmness, Śiva may one be.

[vbt-p11-v110] Like the waves of water, the flame-plays of fire, the sun's light: of me indeed, of Bhairava — these world-plays, manifested.
chunks.sanskrit: indrajālamayaṃ viśvaṃ vyastaṃ vā citrakarmavat | bhramad vā dhyāyataḥ sarvam paśyataś ca sukhodgamaḥ na cittaṃ nikṣiped duḥkhe na sukhe vā parikṣipet | bhairavi jñāyatāṃ madhye kiṃ tattvam avaśiṣyate vihāya nijadehasthaṃ sarvatrāsmīti bhāvayan | dṛḍhena manasā dṛṣṭyā nānyekṣiṇyā sukhī bhavet ghaṭādau yac ca vijñānam icchādyaṃ vā mamāntare | naiva sarvagataṃ jātam bhāvayan iti sarvagaḥ grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittiḥ sāmānyā sarvadehinām | yogināṃ tu viśeṣo =B9sti sambandhe sāvadhānatā svavad anyaśarīre =B9pi saṃvittim anubhāvayet | apekṣāṃ svaśarīrasya tyaktvā vyāpī dinair bhavet nirādhāraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā vikalpān na vikalpayet | tadātmaparamātmatve bhairavo mṛgalocane sarvajñaḥ sarvakartā ca vyāpakaḥ parameśvaraḥ | sa evāhaṃ śaivadharmā iti dārḍhyāc chivo bhavet jalasyevormayo vahner jvālābhaṅgyaḥ prabhā raveḥ | mamaiva bhairavasyaitā viśvabhaṅgyo vibheditāḥ bhrāntvā bhrāntvā śarīreṇa tvaritam bhuvi pātanāt | kṣobhaśaktivirāmeṇa parā saṃjāyate daśā

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p12-v112] On supports or by power, by knowing, or from mind-dissolving: born at power-penetration's end — the Bhairava form.

[vbt-p12-v113] This tradition, O Goddess, hear — rightly I tell: even freedom is born at once, when the eyes are unwinkingly fixed.

[vbt-p12-v114] Contraction of the ears having been made — at the lower gate likewise: unsmeared, unploughed, meditating, one may enter eternal brahman.

[vbt-p12-v115] At a well and such, a great pit — having stood above, from looking: of undivided mind rightly, at once mind-dissolving, plainly.

[vbt-p12-v116] Wherever the mind goes — outside or inside, or even so: there, there Śiva-state — by pervasiveness: where would it go?

[vbt-p12-v117] Wherever by the eye's road, consciousness is manifested of the pervader: of him, from only-that-natured, from cit-dissolving — full-selfness.

[vbt-p12-v118] At hunger's end and such — in fear, in grief, in the abyss, or fled from battle; at curiosity-thirst's end: reality-being-full state.

[vbt-p12-v119] In things being remembered, when seen — in place, the mind should leave: one's own body unsupported made, the lord spreads forth.

[vbt-p12-v120] Anywhere, on a thing placed — slowly the gaze should withdraw: that knowing, mind-with — O Goddess, void-abode may it be.
chunks.sanskrit: ādhāreṣv athavā 'śaktyā 'jñānāc cittalayena vā | jātaśaktisamāveśakṣobhānte bhairavaṃ vapuḥ sampradāyam imam devi śṛṇu samyag vadāmy aham | kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ saṃkocaṃ karṇayoḥ kṛtvā hy adhodvāre tathaiva ca | anackam ahalaṃ dhyāyan viśed brahma sanātanam kūpādike mahāgarte sthitvopari nirīkṣaṇāt | avikalpamateḥ samyak sadyas cittalayaḥ sphuṭam yatra yatra mano yāti bāhye vābhyantare 'pi vā | tatra tatra śivāvāsthā vyāpakatvāt kva yāsyati yatra yatrākṣamārgeṇa caitanyaṃ vyajyate vibhoḥ | tasya tanmātradharmitvāc cillayād bharitātmatā kṣutādyante bhaye śoke gahvare vā raṇād drute | kutūhalekṣudhādyante brahmasattāmayī daśā vastuṣu smaryamāṇeṣu dṛṣṭe deśe manas tyajet | svaśarīraṃ nirādhāraṃ kṛtvā prasarati prabhuḥ kvacid vastuni vinyasya śanair dṛṣṭiṃ nivartayet | taj jñānaṃ cittasahitaṃ devi śūnyālāyo bhavet bhaktyudrekād viraktasya yādṛśī jāyate matiḥ | sā śaktiḥ śāṅkarī nityam bhavayet tāṃ tataḥ śivaḥ

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p13-v122] In things inside, being known — in all things, voidness: her indeed, by mind meditated — known even, becomes calm.

[vbt-p13-v123] By slightly knowing which is remembered purity — that purity in Śambhu's view: not pure, nor impure therefore — thought-free, happy may he be.

[vbt-p13-v124] Everywhere Bhairava's state — even in common things, the object: not apart from that higher thus — the nondual going.

[vbt-p13-v125] Same in enemy and in friend; same in honor and dishonor: of brahman's fullness — thus having known, happy may he be.

[vbt-p13-v126] Not hatred should one contemplate anywhere, not passion anywhere: free of passion and hatred — in the middle, brahman glides forth.

[vbt-p13-v127] Whatever unknowable, whatever ungraspable, whatever void, whatever gone to nonbeing: that all as Bhairava to be contemplated — at that end, awakening arises.

[vbt-p13-v128] In the eternal, in the supportless, in the void, in the pervasive, free of counting: mind made in the outer sky — into the skyless should enter.

[vbt-p13-v129] Wherever the mind goes — that, that by that very thing at that moment: having left non-standing — waveless then may it be.

[vbt-p13-v130] By fear all makes resound — giving all, pervasive in wholeness: hence of Bhairava's word, from constant uttering — Śiva.
chunks.sanskrit: vastvantare vedyamāne sarvavastuṣu śūnyatā | tām eva manasā dhyātvā vidito 'pi praśāmyati kiṃcijjñair yā smṛtā śuddhiḥ sā śuddhiḥ śambhudarśane | na śucir hy aśucis tasmān nirvikalpaḥ sukhī bhavet sarvatra bhairavo bhāvaḥ sāmānyeṣv api gocaraḥ | na ca tadvyatirekteṇa paro 'stīty advayā gatiḥ samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca samo mānāvamānayoḥ || brahmaṇaḥ paripūrṇatvāt iti jñātvā sukhī bhavet na dveṣam bhāvayet kvāpi na rāgam bhāvayet kvacit | rāgadveṣavinirmuktau madhye brahma prasarpati yad avedyaṃ yad agrāhyaṃ yac chūnyaṃ yad abhāvagam | tat sarvam bhairavam bhāvyaṃ tadante bodhasambhavaḥ nitye nirāśraye śūnye vyāpake kalanojjhite | bāhyākāśe manaḥ kṛtvā nirākāśaṃ samāviśet yatra yatra mano yāti tat tat tenaiva tatkṣaṇam | parityajyānavasthityā nistaraṅgas tato bhavet bhayā sarvaṃ ravayati sarvado vyāpako 'khile | iti bhairavaśabdasya santatoccāraṇāc chivaḥ ahaṃ mamedam ityādi pratipattiprasaṅgataḥ | nirādhāre mano yāti taddhyānapreraṇāc chamī

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p14-v132] Eternal, all-pervading, supportless, pervasive, and lord of all: words moment by moment meditated — aim done according to meaning.

[vbt-p14-v133] Non-reality, Indra-net-shine — this all standing: what reality of the Indra-net? Thus from firmness, calm may go.

[vbt-p14-v134] Of self, unwavering — where knowing, where action? Knowing-dependent outer states: hence void, this world.

[vbt-p14-v135] Not of me bondage, not freedom — of the frightened, these terrors: this reflection of the intellect in waters, like the sun's.

[vbt-p14-v136] Sense-doored, all — meeting pleasure, pain and such: senses thus having left, self-abiding — in one's own self one abides.

[vbt-p14-v137] Knowing-lighting all — by all self lighting: one, from one-natureness — knowing, knowable, is envisioned.

[vbt-p14-v138] Mental, consciousness, power, self, and mind — the fourfold: when, O dear, fully wasted — then that Bhairava form.

[vbt-p14-v139] Of waveless teachings, a hundred told in brief; twelve-plus — O Goddess, which having known, the knowing-knower person.

[vbt-p14-v140] Here and in one, yoked — he becomes Bhairava himself: by speech does deeds — curse-and-favor making.
chunks.sanskrit: nityo vibhur nirādhāro vyāpakaś cākhilādhipaḥ | śabdān pratikṣaṇaṃ dhyāyan kṛtārtho 'rthānurūpataḥ atattvam indrajālābham idaṃ sarvam avasthitam | kiṃ tattvam indrajālasya iti dārḍhyāc chamaṃ vrajet ātmano nirvikārasya kva jñānaṃ kva ca vā kriyā | jñānāyattā bahirbhāvā ataḥ śūnyam idaṃ jagat na me bandho na mokṣo me bhītasyaitā vibhīṣikāḥ | pratibimbam idam buddher jaleṣv iva vivasvataḥ indriyadvārakaṃ sarvaṃ sukhaduḥkhādisaṃgamam | itīndriyāṇi saṃtyajya svasthaḥ svātmani vartate jñānaprakāśakaṃ sarvaṃ sarveṇātmā prakāśakaḥ | ekam ekasvabhāvatvāt jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ vibhāvyate mānasaṃ cetanā śaktir ātmā ceti catuṣṭayam | yadā priye parikṣīṇaṃ tadā tad bhairavaṃ vapuḥ nistaraṅgopadeśānāṃ śatam uktaṃ samāsataḥ | dvādaśābhyadhikaṃ devi yaj jñātvā jñānavij janaḥ atra caikatame yukto jāyate bhairavaḥ svayam | vācā karoti karmāṇi śāpānugrahakārakaḥ ajarāmaratām eti so 'ṇimādiguṇānvitaḥ | yoginīnām priyo devi sarvamelāpakādhipaḥ

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p15-v143] In the state thus told — who mutters, who does muting, and who meditates: who is worshipped, O great lord, and who is pleased?

[vbt-p15-v145] Again, again in the supreme state — which contemplation is contemplated indeed: muting there itself — self-sound, mantra-natured — such the to-be-muted.

[vbt-p15-v146] Meditation indeed: unmoving intellect, formless, supportless; not meditation — the imagining of body, eye, mouth, hand and such.

[vbt-p15-v147] Worship is named not by flowers and such — which mind is made firm: in the undifferentiated great sky, that worship indeed from care, dissolving.

[vbt-p15-v148] Here in one or another yoking-standing, when it may arise from day to day: full-formed state — right here contentment, utter fullness.

[vbt-p15-v149] In the great void-abode, in the fire — sense-objects and such: offered by mind, with all oblation, with the awareness-ladle.

[vbt-p15-v150] The sacrifice here, O highest lady — contentment, bliss-marked: from wasting all sins, from protecting all — O mountain's daughter.
chunks.sanskrit: jīvann api vimukto 'sau kurvann api na lipyate | śrī devī uvāca | idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara evamuktavyavasthāyāṃ japyate ko japaś ca kaḥ | dhyāyate ko mahānātha pūjyate kaś ca tṛpyati hūyate kasya vā homo yāgaḥ kasya ca kiṃ katham | śrī bhairava uvāca | eṣātra prakriyā bāhyā sthūleṣv eva mṛgekṣaṇe bhūyo bhūyaḥ pare bhāve bhāvanā bhāvyate hi yā | japaḥ so 'tra svayaṃ nādo mantrātmā japya īdṛśaḥ dhyānaṃ hi niścalā buddhir nirākārā nirāśrayā | na tu dhyānaṃ śarīrākṣimukhahastādikalpanā pūjā nāma na puṣpādyair yā matiḥ kriyate dṛḍhā | nirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hy ādarāl layaḥ atraikatamayuktisthe yotpadyeta dinād dinam | bharitākāratā sātra tṛptir atyantapūrṇatā mahāśūnyālaye vahnau bhūtākṣaviṣayādikam | hūyate manasā sārdhaṃ sa homaś cetanāsrucā yāgo 'tra parameśāni tuṣṭir ānandalakṣaṇā | kṣapaṇāt sarvapāpānāṃ trāṇāt sarvasya pārvati rudraśaktisamāveśas tat kṣetram bhāvanā parā | anyathā tasya tattvasya kā pūjā kāś ca tṛpyati

chunks.l2:
[vbt-p16-v152] Free-bliss-consciousness-mere-essence — one's own self everywhere: entering in that form — one's own self's bath, declared.

[vbt-p16-v153] By which indeed is one worshipped, with materials pleased — or higher-lower: who indeed the worshipper — all he, the very one: where the worship?

[vbt-p16-v154] Breath may go, life may enter — by will, crooked-formed: long-formed she, the great goddess — other field, higher-lower.

[vbt-p16-v155] In this walking along, standing in the great-bliss-made path: by her, by the goddess entered — supreme Bhairava may attain.

[vbt-p16-v156] Six hundreds by day, by night a thousand twenty-one: the goddess's muting declared — easy, hard for the dull.

[vbt-p16-v157] Thus this told, O Goddess — supreme nectar, the highest: this and never to be shown of anyone, but ever.

[vbt-p16-v158] To another pupil, to the base, to the cruel, the non-devoted — of the guru's feet: but of thought-free-minded, of heroes, of lofty-souled.

[vbt-p16-v159] To the devoted, of the guru's company — to be given without hesitation: village, kingdom, town, country, son, wife, family.

[vbt-p16-v160] All this having left — this to be grasped, O deer-eyed one: what with these unsteady, O Goddess? This steady, supreme wealth; lives even to be given — the supreme nectar not to be given.
chunks.sanskrit: svatantrānandacinmātrasāraḥ svātmā hi sarvataḥ | āveśanaṃ tatsvarūpe svātmanaḥ snānam īritam yair eva pūjyate dravyais tarpyate vā parāparaḥ | yaś caiva pūjakaḥ sarvaḥ sa evaikaḥ kva pūjanam vrajet prāṇo viśej jīva icchayā kuṭilākṛtiḥ | dīrghātmā sā mahādevī parakṣetram parāparā asyām anucaran tiṣṭhan mahānandamaye 'dhvare | tayā devyā samāviṣṭaḥ param bhairavam āpnuyāt ṣaṭśatāni divā rātrau sahasrāṇyekaviṃśatiḥ | japo devyāḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sulabho durlabho jaḍaiḥ ity etat kathitaṃ devi paramāmṛtam uttamam | etac ca naiva kasyāpi prakāśyaṃ tu kadācana paraśiṣye khale krūre abhakte gurupādayoḥ | nirvikalpamatīnāṃ tu vīrāṇām unnatātmanām bhaktānāṃ guruvargasya dātavyaṃ nirviśaṅkayā | grāmo rājyam puraṃ deśaḥ putradārakuṭumbakam sarvam etat parityajya grāhyam etan mṛgekṣaṇe | kim ebhir asthirair devi sthiram param idaṃ dhanam | prāṇā api pradātavyā na deyaṃ paramāmṛtam śrī devī uvāca | devadeva māhadeva paritṛptāsmi śaṅkara | rudrayāmalatantrasya sāram adyāvadhāritam

chunks.l2: [vbt-p17-v162] Of all the power-divisions, the heart known today, and: having spoken thus, delighted, the goddess on the neck — clung to Śiva's.
chunks.sanskrit: sarvaśaktiprabhedānāṃ hṛdayaṃ jñātam adya ca | ity uktvānanditā devi ka.ṅthe lagnā śivasya tu
